description: Leaf natural-language calls with exact answers: no callable functions, services, files or Neuralese. Measures the leafCalls / decisionReadout surfaces against the full interpreter surface.

functions.ticket.nl:
---
args:
  ticket: string
returns: "\"billing\" | \"technical\" | \"other\""
---
Classify ticket as billing (charges, invoices or payments), technical (errors or bugs), or other. Return only the matching label.
functions.sentiment.nl:
---
args:
  review: string
returns: "\"positive\" | \"negative\" | \"neutral\""
---
Judge the sentiment the writer of review expresses. A statement of fact without an opinion is neutral.
functions.deadline.nl:
---
args:
  message: string
returns: boolean
---
Decide whether message asks for something to be done by a specific time or date.
functions.language.nl:
---
args:
  text: string
returns: "\"en\" | \"de\" | \"fr\" | \"es\""
---
Identify the language text is written in.
functions.email.nl:
---
args:
  text: string
returns: string
---
Return the email address mentioned in text, exactly as written.
functions.city.nl:
---
args:
  text: string
returns: string
---
Return the name of the city where the event in text takes place.
functions.isodate.nl:
---
args:
  text: string
returns: string
---
Return the date mentioned in text in ISO format, YYYY-MM-DD.
functions.capital.nl:
---
args:
  country: string
returns: string
---
Return the name of the capital city of country, in English.
functions.total.nl:
---
args:
  items: "{ name: string; price: number; quantity: number }[]"
returns: number
---
Return the total cost of items: the sum of price times quantity over all items.
functions.words.nl:
---
args:
  sentence: string
returns: number
---
Return the number of words in sentence.
functions.person.nl:
---
args:
  note: string
returns: "{ name: string; age: number }"
---
Extract the full name and the age of the person described in note.
functions.address.nl:
---
args:
  line: string
returns: "{ street: string; city: string; postcode: string }"
---
Split the postal address in line into its street (with house number), city and postcode, each exactly as written.
functions.hashtags.nl:
---
args:
  post: string
returns: string[]
---
List the hashtags in post in the order they appear, each with its leading #.
functions.sort.nl:
---
args:
  names: string[]
returns: string[]
---
Sort names alphabetically, ignoring upper and lower case, and return them exactly as written.
